facts.fact: The Zambia Information and Communications Technology Authority (ZICTA) opened a consultation on 21 October 2026 on its draft revised ICT (Type Approval) Guidelines, inviting operators, importers, civil society, academics and the public to comment until 20 November 2026.
facts.system: ZICTA draft revised Type Approval Guidelines consultation
